query: What train/validation/test split protocol (by block/family/date/version) and target sample sizes per family will prevent leakage while enabling robust generalization across analog families?

response.query: What train/validation/test split protocol (by block/family/date/version) and target sample sizes per family will prevent leakage while enabling robust generalization across analog families?
response.answer: Use family-based split to prevent leakage, with 70% training, 15% validation, and 15% test. Ensure each family has at least 100 samples for robust generalization.
